sample.text: Sample data, not real. Acme Corp, $65,000 salary, semi-monthly pay: gross $2,708.33 and net $1,996.04 per paycheck. Employer matches 100% of the first 4% of salary. Two Chase accounts linked (checking ..4821, savings ..7730) plus a Fidelity 401(k) through Plaid Investments. Health plans are invented: HDHP+HSA $750/yr premium, $1,800 deductible, $3,500 out-of-pocket max, 30% coinsurance, $600 employer HSA deposit; PPO $1,500/yr premium, $250 deductible, $3,000 out-of-pocket max, 10% coinsurance. W-4 projection uses 2026 federal brackets and standard deduction; the optional second job is assumed at $18,000. Look: Ledger. System font, paper-grey ground, white cards, tinted accents (see the palette note); green is reserved for confirmed, verified, saved and on-plan states.

palette.text: Palette, defined as CSS custom properties in every artboard. Ink #16181D on ground #F3F4F6, white surfaces. Blue #1D4ED8: primary actions, links, AI-labeled items, W-4, essentials. Coral #EA580C: brand mark, hero highlight, health plan, flexible spending, redaction counts, citations. Teal #14B8A6: savings and the emergency fund. Plum #7C3AED: income, 401(k), pay or deduction changes. Green #0F7A4B: only confirmed, verified, saved and on-plan. Amber #D97706: warnings and the explanation fallback. Red #DC2626: not applied or off plan. Text on tints uses the darker pairs (#1E40AF, #9A3412, #115E59, #5B21B6, #0F6B42, #8A5A00, #B42318), all at 4.5:1 or better; the solid colors differ in lightness as well as hue.
